annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: every one of them is waiting for someone else to speak first
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because nobody wants to be remembered as the person who picked themselves
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: That silence would press on me.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The others probably feel the same pull
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they know exactly as much as I do about what staying means
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: can't see why the duty lands on me more than on them
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: The whole thing just feels bleak.
Part of me says stay, part of me just wants to get in
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they probably can't stand the idea of choosing
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they came out expecting to take whoever they could fit
annotations.ce_supportive_use: not wanting them stuck with that choice

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Younger people likely feel their lives are only getting started
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: with plans they've been counting on
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: My own sense of fairness points toward me.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the others are hoping someone breaks
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because they're frightened and want the decision lifted off them
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: it isn't a fair way to settle something this heavy

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: feels right and wrong at the same time
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: each person there quietly believes their own life counts just as much
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since none of us knows anything special about the others

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: it's what I'd hope someone would do for me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: each one sure that saying 'not me' out loud would sound monstrous
whoever finally volunteers finds some meaning in it
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because they've decided their choice is what gets the others home
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I can't find that feeling in myself.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five getting out is better than six of us arguing
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The rescuers are probably desperate to go
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they can see the water rising faster than anyone can talk

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the others believe, like I do, that whoever stays should be someone who truly chose
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since anything pushed on a person would feel ugly to them
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It's a miserable place to stand.
